title: This issue may allow an IPMI authenticated administrator to execute commands as the operating system root user on the…
description: An IPMI authenticated administrator may be able to execute commands as the operating system root user on the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC). This vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.6, indicating a medium severity level. It involves command execution with high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability. No affected versions or patch information are provided.
